mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth rate > 2.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms as monetary policy tightens, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth rate > 2.0%, or the walk-forward Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening with economic weakness, increasing equity risk premiums and reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
